reviews.text: My shopping experience here was outstanding, largely thanks to Ms. Dipali. Her expertise and friendly demeanor made buying gold a pleasure. She took the time to understand my preferences and helped me choose a perfect gold lohori. The lohori itself is beautiful and of great quality. Thank you, Ms. Dipali, for your wonderful service! Overall the experience was very good and all the staff are very humble and well behaved.

The collection is vast and very attractive. All the support staff is very courteous and understand the requirement precisely. Ms. Sudipa is really a gem of a person with whom we instantly feel a connect. She was very attentive and very articulate in explaining and suggesting the design as well the gold scheme.
We are hooked, that's what our experience is in a single line. Very much recommended!!!!

Had a pleasant experience buying jewellery here for my mom. A special thanks to Mr. Kaushik Biswas, who assisted us throughout the process. He was extremely patient, knowledgeable, and courteous—making the entire selection process smooth and enjoyable. Truly appreciate his support in helping us find the perfect piece. Highly recommended!
It's really very good that bengalis need not to wait to go to their native for buying nowa, shakha, pola etc. pc Chandra is in Marathahalli currently and collection and service is really good.
Nice collection and designs in gold jewellery, bought a necklace this week, really satisfied with the collection and staff behaviour particularly from Leela, looking for more visits in future
Very good service and recommendations from Leela. Guided us really well. Design was very quickly liked by us. Really nice experience.
Amazing store. The first time I visited Dipali was helping me for the purchase I am delighted for her behaviour 😊
Good jeweller in bangalore. Very supportive staff. Ashwini is so kind and helpful
Sudipa is very friendly and good person thank you
